messages.subject: Knjige Zuur et al.
messages.body_plain:
Pozdravljeni Rkoholiki,

ima kdo od vas morda katero od teh novejših (po letu 2009) knjig Zuur et al. ekipe?

Zero inflated Models and Generalized Linear Mixed Models with R <http://www.highstat.com/book4.htm> (2012)
A Beginner's Guide to Generalized Additive Models with R <http://www.highstat.com/BGGAM.htm> (2012)
A Beginner's Guide to GLM and GLMM with R <http://www.highstat.com/BGGLM.htm> (2013)
A Beginner's Guide to Generalized Additive Mixed Models with R <http://www.highstat.com/BGGAMM.htm> (2014)
A Beginner's Guide to Zero-Inflated Models with R <http://www.highstat.com/BGZIM.htm> (2016)

Če jih kdo ima, ste zadovoljni z njimi in bi jih priporočali?
Razmišljam namreč malce o nakupu katere od teh.
Teme se sicer očitno precej prekrivajo, vendar vsaka od knjig deluje precej obetavno.

Mimogrede, če kdo rabi/želi, imam PDF verzijo "Zuur et al 2009 - Mixed Effects Models and Extensions in Ecology with R" in jo z veseljem delim.

LP in srečno novo leto!

Tilen
